title: Review-convergence-v6
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — one P0 test regression will produce false CI green if the test suite doesn't run reader config tests; one silent IMAP auth failure vector if credential_file is used; otherwise well-bounded scope
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — the BuildStoreError manual Display/From is the main non-idiomatic choice; everything else is correct Rust. The .to_string()/.to_owned() on literals is a minor clippy-level nit.
Confidence: 10% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: IMAP credential_file gap is real but only triggers if an operator configures credential_file in an IMAP-only deployment. Uncertainty driven by: not running cargo test to confirm the stale assertion actually fails (the string mismatch is obvious from reading code). Would raise confidence if: ran cargo test -p stoa-reader to confirm P0 failure.
Rust idiom confidence: 15% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: the .to_string() vs .to_owned() in smtp is real but clippy catches it; no missed lifetime or ownership issues. Uncertainty driven by: not running cargo clippy.
